_comment: Hand-curated submissions: ecosystem artifacts that are not repositories.
A social post, a demo, a write-up with its own recording. Same pipeline,
same grading, but the media comes from the post rather than a README.
Why this file exists: some of the most interesting Jev work appears as a
post with a screen recording days before it becomes a repository, and some
never becomes one at all. A source list built only from repository search
media.video   candidate URLs, best-last; media.py picks the largest under
the resolution cap and transcodes it to a GIF
media.poster  a still for the card, used when no GIF can be produced
project_url   the upstream project this post is about, when the author
links one. Rendered as a prominent guide link.
replies_url   where that link was found, so the claim stays checkable

title.zh-CN: Xtags — X 帖子意图标注插件

submissions.author: yishan

summary.en: Xtags: a Chrome extension that labels each post in an X timeline with what it is trying to get from you — inducement, provocation, promotion, machine-generated, persuasion, entertainment, information — drawn as a tag plus a probability right after the timestamp. A side panel reports session counts (seen, judged, correct) and cumulative token cost. The author reports near-instant responses and usable accuracy before any tuning.
summary.zh-CN: Xtags：一个 Chrome 插件，在 X 时间线上给每条帖子标出「它想让你干什么」——诱导、挑拨、推销、机器生成、说服、娱乐、告知——以「标签 + 概率」的形式画在时间戳之后。右侧面板汇报本次会话的统计（总计 / 跳过 / 看过 / 判定 / 对了 / 失败）与累计 Token 花费。作者称几乎秒级响应，且在未细调的情况下分类已相当准。

notes.en: Worth reading as a latency argument rather than an accuracy one: labelling a timeline only works if the decision costs less than the scroll, which is the constraint a generative model cannot meet.
notes.zh-CN: 它的价值不在准确率而在延迟论证：要让「滚动时逐条标注」成立，单次判断必须比滚动本身更便宜——这正是生成式模型无法满足的约束。

submissions.source_note: Submitted by the maintainer 2026-09-18. Project link and updated metrics read from the author's own reply in the thread on 2026-09-19.
